 On October 24, 2026, Mainz and Werder will face off in the 7th round of Germany's Bundesliga . A battle between two mid-table sides this season.
 Mainz - Werder team news and expert analysis
 The club from the Mewa Arena finished in the top 10 of the 2025/2026 table with 40 points. They have made a strong start in away fixtures, but at home have managed no more than draws. They also beat Schalke away, 1-0.
 The Bremen side suffered a serious decline last season, going from European contenders to survival battlers: with just 32 points, they finished only 15th. They started the current campaign with a 1-4 defeat at Freiburg, but then alternated wins with draws — even holding Borussia Dortmund to a 2-2 draw. They repeated that score against Paderborn.
 Titz and his men play entertaining football, averaging 2.33 goals scored and 1.67 conceded. Their next opponents have an even record: two goals scored and two conceded on average.
 Previous matches: Mainz - Werder 
 The current visitors had won four meetings in a row, but last season they managed just one point from the two encounters.
 The visitors are considered underdogs, but that assessment underestimates them. We are backing an away win with a "+1 goal" handicap (odds – 1.64).
 Mainz - Werder: key statistics and trends
 Mainz have won three of their last five matches in this Bundesliga campaign
 50% of Mainz matches have seen both teams score, with an average total of 4.0 goals per game
 Werder are unbeaten in five consecutive matches
 Both teams have scored in 100% of Werder matches, with an average total of 4.0 goals per game
 Mainz - Werder: possible starting lineups
 Mainz play in a 1-3-5-2 formation (possible lineup): Schwolow — Posch, Gruber, Potulski — Kaci, Amiri, Sano, Martel, Mwene — Becker, Tietz
 Werder play in a 1-4-2-3-1 formation (possible lineup): Hein — Arthur, Pieper, Friedl, Deman — Reitz, Reger — Dinkci, Kanteyalo, Grüll — Füllkrug
